## Overview

This page documents computational experiments conducted as part of
the Werewolf Decision AI project.

Experiments will be used to compare mathematical predictions,
simulation results, and AI decision-making.

## Experiment 1 — Werewolf Win Probability

The first experiment investigates the probability of winning in a
simplified Werewolf game.

### Research Question

How does the number of villagers and werewolves affect the
probability of a werewolf victory?

### Method

A simplified game model is defined in which:

- players are divided into villagers and werewolves;
- one player is eliminated during the day;
- a werewolf eliminates a villager during the night;
- the game continues until one side reaches its victory condition.

The theoretical probability will be compared with results obtained
through repeated simulations.

### Results

Results will be added here after the simulation has been implemented.

## Future Experiments

Planned experiments include:

- Comparing different game configurations
- Measuring the value of role information
- Evaluating different decision-making strategies
- Developing an AI for game progression
- Comparing AI decisions with mathematically calculated probabilities
